spec: D-N1-15 RGB demo takes. Selected from results/rgb_demo_scenes.json (480 candidates over 40 AV2-sensor val logs, ranked on vis*span x traffic density x parked-row/intersection geometry x history visibility). Re-render against any checkpoint with:  python scripts/render_rgb_demo.py --takes results/rgb_demo_takes.json --ckpt <path> --ckpt-label <label>

takes.name: A
takes.why: highest composite (3232): fan and GT visible 95% of the future, history 100%, 16 moving vehicles, intersection geometry. Longest clean rolling take.

takes.name: B
takes.why: only take with 100% visibility on BOTH future and history; 21 moving vehicles, intersection. Front camera, so it reads as a dashcam view.

takes.name: C
takes.why: densest traffic in the 40-log pool by 2x (43 fully-observed moving vehicles), intersection, history 100% visible.

takes.name: D
takes.why: strongest occlusion geometry: 24 parked vehicles within 30 m of the focal path, focal travels 136.5 m. Lower future visibility (0.52) is the cost of that geometry and is the point, not a defect.
